newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: At least 13 soccer fans die in Colombia crash.
newsitem.headline: At least 13 soccer fans die in Colombia crash.

text.p: A bus taking soccer fans to a match collided with a truck in western Colombia on Sunday, killing at least 13 people, police said.
The accident occurred as the bus travelled to Armenia, provincial capital of Quindio. The dead were supporters of the Cali-based America club, which was due to meet Armenia on Sunday afternoon.
Soccer players held a minute's silence in memory of the dead before the match.
